metadata.description: Open tools for the built environment, from ibuilder.

plugins.name: master-builder
plugins.description: Reason like a master builder — one mind holding an entire built-asset project from raw land through design, construction, handover, operations and disposition, anywhere in the world. Codes, climate and building science, development finance, pro-forma review, delivery and contracts, risk and insurance, adaptive reuse, carbon, BIM, and construction document intelligence.
